exposure: uterine cavity cleansing with normal saline solution during cesarean delivery
cohort: The participants were 90 pregnant women who underwent elective cesarean delivery, randomly assigned to an intervention group (uterine cavity rinsing with normal saline) or a control group (non-rinsed).
finding: Uterine cavity cleansing with normal saline solution during cesarean delivery significantly decreased the incidence of endometritis at six weeks post-surgery in the intervention group compared to the control group.
